# Cncf Opa Gatekeeper Reviewer

Review OPA/Gatekeeper using its official documentation and repository in the AI Native Infra / Governance, Policy and Security category. An admission controller that validates requests to create and update Pods on Kubernetes clusters, using the Open Policy Agent (OPA).

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
